decisions.reason: This product is closely related to the firm's existing substrate and wafer-processing know-how, and with its own R&D and EU-project experience the firm is likely to learn from early market feedback and improve it rather than withdraw it quickly.

This carrier wafer is an incremental extension of the firm's established handling and packaging offer, fits its strategic direction toward more complex wafer support solutions, and should be easy for the firm to absorb and refine commercially.
